_comment: HELD-OUT paraphrase evaluation (v1.21.1, from the independent v1.21.0 review's recommendation). Each query asks about one eval-corpus session in different words, deliberately avoiding the session's topic/summary keywords where natural language allows. A lexical retrieval stack is EXPECTED to score far below the keyword gold set here — the committed paraphraseFloors record measured reality so semantic regressions (or improvements) are visible, not to advertise competence. Do not quote these floors as retrieval quality; quote them as the honest paraphrase gap.
